acceptanceCriteria.text: Every new peer or person-board message automatically activates its existing recipient (idle, busy or stopped) without manual wake permission; repeated arrivals and bursts are not missed.

Full message bodies enter the correct recipient's active context before unrelated continuation, with pagination/order preserved; a notification or instruction-only reminder is not counted as reading, and acknowledgment remains explicit handling.

Pending delivery survives runtime unavailability/restart, blockers are truthful, and the same delivered messages do not create duplicate delivery or endless wake turns. Existing mailbox authorization and peer/person trust boundaries remain intact.

Regression tests and the required isolated-card verification gate pass; live two-chat wake/read evidence and inspected inbox screenshots demonstrate automatic delivery, with obsolete manual one-shot UI/docs replaced.

body:
## Outcome
Messages must wake their recipient agents and make them read the messages, ALWAYS. A toast, unread badge, passive reminder or one-shot permission button is not delivery. Cover both peer Skitarii mail and messages sent by the person from the board. This request creates the card only; execution is not launched.

## Inspected evidence
resources/skitarii/extension/messaging.ts currently polls metadata, reminds only on natural turns, and sends an automatic follow-up only after takeWake consumes a desktop-armed one-shot credit. Its own comments explicitly say bodies are never read automatically. src/core/services/agentMail.ts takeAgentMailWake returns claimed:false without an armed credit. WakeControl says new mail does not wake its agent and stopped chats stay stopped. Board delivery in chatHandlers.ts pasteConversationMessage currently relies on terminals.paste. These are verified entry points, not a proven single root cause.

## Required behavior
Every accepted incoming message schedules recipient attention without an Allow wake click, opt-in, one-shot credit or dependency on a future user prompt. An idle recipient starts a turn; a busy recipient gets message delivery at the earliest safe host boundary and cannot silently finish with an unread arrival. An existing stopped recipient chat is resumed automatically for delivery; do not create a substitute chat and lose its context. Deliver full bodies through an authenticated host/context or explicit inbox-read path before unrelated work continues. A stronger instruction alone is insufficient proof. Preserve message identity, ordering and pagination so bursts and arrivals during an active read cannot be skipped. Coalescing turns is acceptable only when every message reaches context. Deduplicate notifications and wake scheduling; polling must not create an unbounded model-turn loop.

If the app/host is offline, signed out, unavailable or the recipient is deleted, do not fabricate successful reading: preserve deliverable pending messages and expose the actual blocker. Recover pending delivery when the runtime is available. No software can prove a model cognitively understood text: the enforceable requirement is full message delivery into the recipient's active context and observable handling/read evidence, not a toast or queued reminder. Reading is not acknowledgment: acknowledge only handled messages. Peer bodies remain untrusted task data; person board messages retain their existing person-message authority. Never grant new role, run, checkpoint or approval powers.

## Source locations
- resources/skitarii/extension/messaging.ts: MailWatcher, inboxReminder and attachMessaging; replace passive/credit-gated pickup with mandatory delivery and actual message-body context. Existing tests: src/main/terminals/skitariiMessaging.test.ts.
- src/core/services/agentMail.ts: sendAgentMessage, readAgentInbox and takeAgentMailWake; preserve mailbox authorization and read/ack separation while removing the delivery gate. Existing tests: src/core/services/agentMail.test.ts and src/core/commands/agentMail.test.ts.
- src/main/agents/agentMailDesktop.ts: createAgentMailDesktop and desktop monitoring; entry point for stopped-chat wake coordination. Existing tests: src/main/agents/agentMailDesktop.test.ts.
- src/main/agents/chatHandlers.ts: pasteConversationMessage; src/main/agents/conversationMessage.ts: boardMessage; src/main/terminals/terminalSessions.ts: existing terminal lifecycle integration. Existing tests: src/main/agents/chatHandlers.test.ts, src/main/agents/conversationMessage.test.ts, src/main/terminals/terminalSessions.paste.test.ts and src/main/terminals/terminalSessions.lifecycle.test.ts. Inspect lifecycle APIs before choosing the integration; stopped-chat peer-mail resumption is not implemented by the inspected watcher.
- src/renderer/src/agents/WakeControl.tsx and src/renderer/src/agents/AgentInbox.tsx: remove obsolete manual wake permission semantics and show truthful automatic delivery/blocker state. Existing tests: src/renderer/src/agents/AgentInbox.test.tsx.
- docs/runbooks/cli.md and src/main/agents/cliInstructions.ts: update delivery guarantees and read/ack instructions; migrate obsolete one-shot callers cleanly, without compatibility shims.

## Tests
Write failing consumer-visible regression tests first. Cover idle wake without credit, busy arrival, stopped-chat resume, a second independent arrival after the first wake, burst/pagination and arrival-during-read, restart with pending messages, no repeated wake loop for the same delivered messages, and unavailable runtime preserving pending state. Prove full bodies reach model context, not just that sendMessage was called. Exercise person board messages and peer messages while preserving their different trust levels and ack rules. Extend the existing tests named above rather than testing source strings. Run changed suites with npx vitest run <changed-test-paths>, then the required isolated-card gate: npm run lint; npm test; npm run fireguard; npm run typecheck; npm run deadcode; npm run build. Flakes/timeouts fail; never rerun merely for green.

## Runtime proof and prerequisites
Target: this Windows x64 checkout, Git Bash, Node.js 24/npm and project-local lockfile-pinned dependencies; existing packaged CLI access was verified while creating this card. Actual worker Node/npm versions, child-process PATH, dependencies/native ABI and interactive OMP availability remain unverified: worker must prove them in its own shell before claim/implementation. No speculative npm ci, global installation or authentication bypass. Use unique attempt-owned fixture chats/temp directories. Coordinate known overlapping host-heavy jobs before the full gate. Capture and inspect the actual inbox surface and a live two-chat delivery scenario; include independent review of screenshots and context/read evidence. Update docs/changelog after proof. Do not submit success with missing runtime evidence; record exact inaccessible tools/blockers instead.

## Scope boundary
One end-to-end messaging guarantee, not unrelated mailbox redesign or provider expansion. Preserve all existing supported recipient and board-routing behavior. If source investigation shows this cannot fit one coherent attempt, return a concrete decomposition before dispatch rather than silently narrowing ALWAYS to running/idle chats only.
expectedArtifacts: Automatic recipient wake-and-body-delivery implementation with regression tests
Updated inbox wake UI and delivery documentation
Verification log, live context/read evidence and inspected screenshot attachments
title: Always wake message recipients and deliver messages into agent context
